name: Pauxi
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3, languoid paux1235 'Pauxi' (fetched sources 2026-09-17): MED = Coudreau 1901 (ref 117080, hhtype overview;ethnographic;wordlist, lgcode 'Pianoghotto = Trió [tri], Pauxi [NOCODE_Pauxi]'); other reference Girard 1971 (comments on subclassification).
sources.note: Database record only; confirms that the most extensive description is a wordlist-or-less. No descriptive references beyond Coudreau 1901.

sources.citation: Loukotka, Čestmír. 1968. Classification of South American Indian Languages. Los Angeles: UCLA Latin American Center. p. 205 (Pauxi entry) and comparative table column PAUXI.
sources.note: Only: 'Pauxi or Pawiyana - spoken on the right bank of the middle course of the Erepecurú or Cuminá River; now perhaps extinct. [O. Coudreau 1901, pp. 132-133.]' plus a few comparative forms; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Koch-Grünberg, Theodor. 1908. Die Hianákoto-Umáua. Anthropos 3. Source list 'Pauxi. O. Coudreau: Voyage au Cumina. p. 132–133' and Pauxi forms in the comparative word tables.
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: online with a university library login (also: harvard online access (harvardkey))
sources.note: Re-cites Coudreau's Pauxi forms (touna, capo, topeu, cono-on, coco, noune, siriké, préou) in comparative lists; no statement on Pauxi accent.

sources.citation: Coudreau, Olga (Mme O.). 1901. Voyage au Cuminá, 20 avril 1900 – 7 septembre 1900. Paris: A. Lahure. Pauxi wordlist pp. 132–133.
sources.note: Nothing. The whole record of the language is a 38-item French-gloss wordlist ('Soleil Icire, Lune Noune, Étoile Siriké,... S'en aller Machiconé') dictated by a Mocambeiro (non-Indian) informant, Lothario, which Coudreau prints 'sous toutes réserves'; no remarks on pronunciation, accent or prosody. The acute accents in a few forms (Siriké, Moriré, Préou, Machiconé) are French vowel-quality spellings, not stress marks.

sources.citation: Coudreau, Olga. 1901. Voyage au Cuminá (second scan, Google copy archive.org voyageaucuminav00coudgoog).
sources.note: Same edition, same wordlist; no stress information.
